Beast! Detestable monster!— Transform him, transform this reptile, oh, you, you Infinite Spirit of Earth! Change him into the dog that he once was, cavorting on evening walks, rolling at the feet of the unsuspecting wanderer, bounding onto his shoulders when he falls. Change him back into his favorite form, to grovel before me in the sand on his belly, so I can trample him, trample the depraved creature! “Not the first”! O grief, grief not to be grasped by human soul, that more than one creature has reached this depth of misery; that that first failed to atone for all others in her death agony before the eyes of the ever-forgiving God! The misery of this one, her, cuts me to the marrow of my being! And you stand there grinning coolly across the doom of thousands.

@@U02015@@

translation:
@@U02013@@
野兽！可憎的怪物！——改造他，改造这个爬行动物，哦，你，你无限的大地之灵！把他变成以前的狗，在晚上散步时嬉戏，在毫无戒心的流浪者脚下打滚，在他跌倒时跳到他的肩膀上。把他变回他最喜欢的样子，趴在我面前，趴在沙子里，让我践踏他，践踏这个堕落的生物！ “不是第一个”！噢，悲痛，人类灵魂无法理解的悲痛，不止一个生物已经达到了如此悲惨的程度；在永远宽恕的上帝面前，她在死亡的痛苦中首先未能为所有其他人赎罪！这个人，她的痛苦，让我痛彻心扉！而你站在那里，面对成千上万的厄运，冷酷地笑着。

@@U02015@@
